note: Fixed unstable/wrong pronunciation. Audio now goes through the Pages Worker, which proxies Google translate_tts from outside mainland China (the browser cannot reach Google directly, but the Worker can) with melotts and Youdao as fallbacks - measured 7/7 success. Responses under 1KB are now rejected instead of being played as noise, which was the cause of the non-Chinese sounds. Requests use GET so repeated playback is served from browser cache (instant, always works).
